deduplication.difference: The existing adapter resolves one known arXiv ID. This candidate discovers bounded record IDs from a topic query. The input and output coverage differ.
deduplication.scope_difference: The existing query adapters search PubMed and Europe PMC collections. This candidate searches the arXiv corpus and returns arXiv identifiers and metadata.
deduplication.local_first_rule: Use checked-out source navigation or an existing cluster brief when it already covers the requested source scope.

implementation_boundary.implements: One explicitly authorized, fixed-host, public query that returns at most ten arXiv metadata rows and a bounded receipt.
does_not_implement: Idea generation or the IdeaScientist method
Gap validation, mechanism transfer, proposal evaluation, or independent science review
Paper text, abstract, code, model, dataset, or vault import
implementation_boundary.reuse: No IdeaScientist code, model, paper text, or vault data is copied or loaded.

metadata_and_content_boundary.metadata_license_note: arXiv API terms state that descriptive metadata may be used under CC0 1.0.
metadata_and_content_boundary.article_content_note: The adapter does not return or retain abstracts, article files, or full text; article content remains subject to its own copyright and license.
metadata_and_content_boundary.rate_limit: One legacy API request every three seconds and one connection at a time across all machines controlled by the caller. The wrapper does not implement a shared rate limiter; callers must serialize use.

claim_ceiling: Blueprint-linked bounded source-discovery support and provider-reported metadata only; no blueprint effectiveness, evidence quality, scientific validity, or discovery is established.
